meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用 Google 的 Cirq 框架，帮你写 Python 代码来设计、模拟、运行和优化量子电路，包括噪声建模、参数扫描，以及接入 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件后端。
howto.when: 当你要用 Python 构建、模拟或优化量子电路，在 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件上运行作业，或进行噪声建模、参数扫描、表征实验时触发；若目标是 IBM 硬件，则改用 qiskit。
howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses Google's Cirq framework to help you write Python code for designing, simulating, running, and optimizing quantum circuits, including noise modeling, parameter sweeps, and integration with quantum hardware backends like Google and IonQ.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building/simulating/optimizing quantum circuits in Python, running jobs on backends like Google or IonQ, or doing noise modeling, parameter sweeps, or characterization experiments. For IBM hardware, use qiskit.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to build an H + CNOT circuit, simulate 1000 shots, and show me the histogram.
say_en.note: Runs the circuit and shows measurement counts.

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise at 0.01 and 0.1 to the same Cirq circuit and compare the results.
say_en.note: Runs noisy simulations and compares outputs across noise levels.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to sweep theta from 0 to 2π over 20 points and plot the results.
say_en.note: Executes the parameter sweep and returns measurements for each value.
